body:
**PAYMENT**

Monthly tuition is due the first week of each month. $10 late fee after the 15th. Tuition stays the same each month regardless of absences.

Long-term medical absences (2+ weeks, teacher notified) qualify for adjustments. Lessons cancelled by the teacher will be pro-rated or credited to the next month.

**LESSONS & GROUP ATTENDANCE**

If you can't attend, you may switch with another student. Tardy students have only their remaining time — no make-ups. Group class teaches skills that can't be taught individually. Missing more than one unexcused group class per year may result in a referral to another teacher.

**PRACTICE**

Daily practice includes: scales, drill spots, technique, review, note-reading, and the current piece. Listening is the teacher at home — without it, the ear cannot be trained.

**MONTHLY TUITION**

30-minute lesson: $75.00 | 45-minute lesson: $110.00
